description: This file contains utility functions for handling ARIA roles, attributes, and accessibility features in a web environment, including role inference, attribute checks, and accessible name computation.

methods.name: hasExplicitAccessibleName
methods.description: Checks if an element has an explicit accessible name via aria-label or aria-labelledby.

methods.name: hasGlobalAriaAttribute
methods.description: Checks if an element has any global ARIA attributes, optionally considering role restrictions.

methods.name: hasTabIndex
methods.description: Determines if an element is focusable via tabindex attribute.

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.description: Checks if an element is natively focusable or has a tabindex.

methods.name: isNativelyFocusable
methods.description: Checks if an element is natively focusable based on its tag name and attributes.

methods.name: getImplicitRoleByTagName
methods.description: Infers implicit ARIA role based on element tag name and attributes.

methods.name: getImplicitAriaRole
methods.description: Determines the implicit ARIA role of an element, considering inheritance and presentation roles.

methods.name: getExplicitAriaRole
methods.description: Retrieves the explicit ARIA role assigned via role attribute, validating against allowed roles.

methods.name: getAriaRole
methods.description: Returns the effective ARIA role of an element, considering explicit and implicit roles.

methods.name: getAriaBoolean
methods.description: Converts ARIA boolean attribute string to boolean or undefined.

methods.name: isElementIgnoredForAria
methods.description: Checks if an element is ignored for ARIA purposes based on tag name.

methods.name: isElementHiddenForAria
methods.description: Determines if an element is hidden from ARIA, considering styles, attributes, and hierarchy.

methods.name: belongsToDisplayNoneOrAriaHiddenOrNonSlotted
methods.description: Recursively checks if an element is hidden due to display:none, aria-hidden, or being in a non-rendered slot.

methods.name: getIdRefs
methods.description: Resolves IDREFs in aria-labelledby, aria-owns, and similar attributes to DOM elements.

methods.name: trimFlatString
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string for name/description computation.

methods.name: asFlatString
methods.description: Converts a string to a normalized flat string, preserving non-breaking spaces.

methods.name: queryInAriaOwned
methods.description: Queries elements within aria-owns relationships matching a selector.

methods.name: getCSSContent
methods.description: Retrieves the CSS content property, including pseudo-elements, for accessibility name calculation.

methods.name: parseCSSContentPropertyAsString
methods.description: Parses the CSS content property into a string, supporting tokens like attr().

methods.name: getAriaLabelledByElements
methods.description: Gets referenced elements from aria-labelledby attribute.

methods.name: allowsNameFromContent
methods.description: Determines if a role allows naming from content based on ARIA spec.

methods.name: getElementAccessibleName
methods.description: Computes the accessible name of an element following ARIA and HTML rules.

methods.name: getElementAccessibleDescription
methods.description: Computes the accessible description of an element based on aria-describedby, aria-description, and title.

methods.name: getAriaInvalid
methods.description: Returns the ARIA invalid state of an element.

methods.name: getValidityInvalid
methods.description: Checks if an element's validity state is invalid.

methods.name: getElementAccessibleErrorMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the error message associated with an element via aria-errormessage or validation states.

methods.name: getTextAlternativeInternal
methods.description: Recursively computes the text alternative for an element, considering ARIA and HTML rules.

methods.name: innerAccumulatedElementText
methods.description: Accumulates text content from an element and its children for accessible name.

methods.name: getAriaSelected
methods.description: Determines if an element is selected based on aria-selected or native selection.

methods.name: getAriaChecked
methods.description: Returns the checked state of an element, including 'mixed' for indeterminate checkboxes.

methods.name: getCheckedAllowMixed
methods.description: Returns checked state allowing 'mixed'.

methods.name: getCheckedWithoutMixed
methods.description: Returns checked state without 'mixed'.

methods.name: getChecked
methods.description: Internal function to determine checked state, considering role and input type.

methods.name: getReadonly
methods.description: Returns whether an element is readonly, considering ARIA and native attributes.

methods.name: getAriaPressed
methods.description: Returns the pressed state of a toggle button.

methods.name: getAriaExpanded
methods.description: Returns whether an element is expanded, based on aria-expanded or details open.

methods.name: getAriaLevel
methods.description: Returns the ARIA level of a heading, listitem, row, or treeitem.

methods.name: getAriaDisabled
methods.description: Determines if an element is disabled via native or ARIA attributes.

methods.name: hasExplicitAriaDisabled
methods.description: Recursively checks for aria-disabled attribute in hierarchy.

methods.name: receivesPointerEvents
methods.description: Determines if an element receives pointer events, considering CSS pointer-events and hierarchy.

methods.name: beginAriaCaches
methods.description: Initializes caches used for accessibility computations.

methods.name: endAriaCaches
methods.description: Clears caches used for accessibility computations.
